brief: Early overnight read for Friday, taken about 9 PM ET Thursday, so overnight trend and levels are not yet scored (0); reliable NQ settlement and Globex data were not available. Thursday's AI and chip sell-off after Meta's results sent the Nasdaq Composite down 2.6% and VIX up 14% to 19.03, while oil jumped on Iran and Houthi tensions. The 10-year yield fell about 17 bp to 4.96% and the dollar is slightly softer against the yen, which is the main offset. Key risk is further tech de-risking ahead of next week's FOMC; the Fed is in its blackout period, and Friday's data are flash PMIs and final UMich sentiment.
